claim: On Wednesday 25 November 2026 the European Parliament approves the joint text of the 2027 EU budget with at least 420 votes in favour.

runs.scenario: If the plenary announcement and press release give 420 votes in favour but Parliament’s roll-call record gives 419 because of a tally correction unrelated to individual MEP filings, one reader could use the announced result and another the official roll-call record. The criterion does not say which takes precedence.
runs.yes_requires: The European Parliament plenary must approve the conciliation joint text of the 2027 EU general budget (procedure 2026/0196(BUD), report A10-0305/2026) on 25 November 2026 within the stated Strasbourg local-time window, with at least 420 votes in favour on the joint text itself.

runs.decided_by: The European Parliament plenary announcement, press release, official minutes/roll-call results (doceo PV, RCV), or HowTheyVote.eu.

runs.scenario: Those sources disagree on the in-favour total and the figures straddle 420 — for example the President announces 421 while the roll-call or HowTheyVote.eu shows 419 — and the criterion names them with 'and'/'or' but sets no priority if they conflict.
